message.content:
{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: run-tests

on:
  pull_request:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
    paths:
      - '**.php'
      - '.github/workflows/run-tests.yml'
      - 'phpunit.xml.dist'
      - 'composer.json'
      - 'composer.lock'
      - 'package.json'
      - 'yarn.lock'

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  javascript-dependencies:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v5

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: 24
          cache: yarn

      - name: Validate lockfile and dependency integrity
        run: yarn install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts

  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        php: ['8.5', '8.6']
        laravel: ['13.*']
        stability: [prefer-lowest, prefer-stable]
        include:
          - laravel: 13.*
            testbench: ^11.1

    name: P${{ matrix.php }} - L${{ matrix.laravel }} - ${{ matrix.stability }}

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - name: Install rsync
        run: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y rsync

      - name: Configure SSH for test containers
        run: |
          chmod 600 tests/docker/keys/laravel_backup_server_id_rsa
          mkdir -p ~/.ssh
          printf 'Host 0.0.0.0\n  StrictHostKeyChecking no\n  UserKnownHostsFile /dev/null\n' >> ~/.ssh/config

      - name: Setup PHP
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@v2
        with:
          php-version: ${{ matrix.php }}
          extensions: dom, curl, libxml, mbstring, zip, pcntl, pdo, sqlite, pdo_sqlite, bcmath, soap, intl, gd, exif, iconv, imagick
          coverage: none

      - name: Setup problem matchers
        run: |
          echo "::add-matcher::${{ runner.tool_cache }}/php.json"
          echo "::add-matcher::${{ runner.tool_cache }}/phpunit.json"

      - name: Cache Composer dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.composer/cache/files
          key: composer-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('composer.lock') }}

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          composer require "laravel/framework:${{ matrix.laravel }}" "orchestra/testbench:${{ matrix.testbench }}" --no-interaction --no-update
          composer update --${{ matrix.stability }} --prefer-dist --no-interaction

      - name: Execute tests
        run: ./vendor/bin/pest --compact",
  "rationale": "The test job runs composer update on every matrix job without caching downloaded Composer packages, while the javascript-dependencies job already caches yarn. The repository has a committed composer.lock (also a path filter), so repeated dependency fetching is measurable and a lockfile-keyed cache input exists. Adding a Composer dependency cache step before install preserves every test step, matrix combination, and required check; it only avoids re-downloading already-fetched packages. This matches P-LIT-GHA-CACHE (dependency_cache): preconditions met (repeated fetching, lockfile-based input), no contraindications (no equivalent Composer cache exists; the package cache is content-addressed, so no untrusted/mutable content is served). Permissions are unchanged and no secrets, privileged actions, publishing/deployment, or new network access beyond the standard Actions cache service are introduced.",
  "evidence_ids": ["pattern:P-LIT-GHA-CACHE"]
}
